claimUnderTest: The authenticated payroll-adjustment backend must reject proposal, approval and export when currency, minor-unit exponent and authoritative cost-evidence provenance are absent.

scope.environment: independent local execution of the exact repository-sealed runtime artifact

rootCause: The sealed payroll adjustment contract derives and persists grossPenceDelta under an implicit GBP-only model. Proposal, approval and export validate roles, revision and source fingerprints but never bind the amount to currency, minor-unit exponent or an authoritative cost-evidence source. The server dispatches these domain actions directly, so the repaired client guard is not a security or integrity boundary.
requiredRepair: Bind every stored adjustment to an authoritative currency code, minor-unit exponent and immutable cost-evidence source.
Reject absent, mismatched, unsupported or unsafe monetary provenance independently at proposal, approval and export.
Replace the implicit GBP CSV contract with an explicit versioned schema and independently reconcile exported integer minor units.
Retain separation of duties, source-fingerprint checks, revision checks and audit linkage while adding provenance enforcement.
requiredRetest: Make all three adversarial tests pass against a newly sealed exact artifact, then repeat the authenticated HTTP proposal-to-export attack and prove rejection at proposal, approval and export while SQLite save/readback, safe restart, audit verification and independently reconciled valid-currency exports remain intact.
